name: calc_card_no_adjacent_subsets
statement: (n : ℕ) : ((Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin n))).filter (fun s => ∀ i : Fin n, ∀ j : Fin n, i ∈ s → j ∈ s → (i : ℕ) + 1 ≠ (j : ℕ))).card = Nat.fib (n + 2)
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ), ((Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin n))).filter (fun s => ∀ i : Fin n, ∀ j : Fin n, i ∈ s → j ∈ s → (i : ℕ) + 1 ≠ (j : ℕ))).card = Nat.fib (n + 2)
informal: Subsets of {0,…,n−1} with no two consecutive elements number F_{n+2} — two-step induction: split by whether the last element is in the set, giving a(n+2) = a(n+1) + a(n); bijections via Fin.castSucc / Finset.map.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), {s | ∀ (i j : Fin n), i ∈ s → j ∈ s → ↑i + 1 ≠ ↑j}.card = Nat.fib (n + 2)
